title: finding(scripts): `cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs` is a LIVE second instance of the unflushed-`process.exit` truncation — 3 of 5 piped runs truncated at 3 different points, and the class needs one uniform rule rather than a per-script size audit
body:
## The finding

`scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs` is a **live second instance** of the defect objectui#10006 fixes: it ends on `process.exit(main(process.argv.slice(2)));` while printing more than the 64 KiB a pipe holds, so its output is truncated at a load-dependent point.

Measured today by the dev on objectui#10006 while fixing the first instance. Five piped runs of the identical command against a 103,937-char capture to a **file**:

| run | chars received |
|---:|---:|
| 1 | 70,757 |
| 2 | 25,656 |
| 3 | 27,132 |
| 4 | 103,937 |
| 5 | 103,937 |

⇒ **three of five truncated, at three different cut points**, exit 0 every time.

⚠️ **Mitigating today, and it is timing rather than safety**: its only in-repo consumer imports its `judge` export instead of spawning it, so nothing is red from it yet. ⛔ That is not a reason to leave it — a human reading its output is already being lied to, silently and without an error.

## The class, bounded by measurement rather than by grep

⛔ A grep cannot see this class: output volume is a **runtime** property and it grows with the tree, so a script that is under the threshold today crosses it silently later.

- 89 of 107 scanned `scripts/**` + `.claude/hooks/**` files carry a non-comment `process.exit(`.
- 47 of those are named by a `scripts/__tests__` file that captures spawn output.
- ⭐ Neither number is the finding. The intersection that matters is **「ends on `process.exit`」 AND 「can print more than 64 KiB」**, and measured today that set has exactly **two** members: `cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs` (103,937 chars) and the one objectui#10006 closes. Next largest is `tsconfig-test-parity-census.mjs` at 23,582 — under today, on a curve that only goes up.

⇒ ⭐ **The suggested repair is one uniform rule, ⛔ not a per-script size audit**: set `process.exitCode` and let Node drain, never `process.exit`. objectui#10006's fix carries a docblock explaining precisely when that substitution is safe and when it becomes a hang instead — reuse it rather than re-deriving it.

## Reachable radius

Measurements are runs on one box today. ⛔ Outside the radius: other machines, CI runners, and any script whose output size changes with the tree. ⇒ re-take before acting.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat #1 (`session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf`) from the `out_of_scope_findings` of objectui#10006's delivery — devs do not file, seats do. ⛔ Filed bare.

## Dedupe words

`cross-file-line-citation-census truncated` · `process.exit stdout pipe flush scripts` · `unflushed exit class scripts` · `exitCode not exit gate` · `64 KiB pipe truncation scripts`
